description.raw: Passive. When Voracia deals damage to at least 3 enemies or all surviving enemies with a skill, her appetite awakens, immediately granting Fervor to that skill. Active. Voracia remains unaffected. She summons a plate covering a 1-tile radius on a target tile. She uses her threads to pull enemies within 2 tiles onto the plate, knocking them down for 4s. Voracia then samples the "food" on the plate, dealing 800% (ATK-based) + 100% (SP-based) damage to each enemy and healing herself for 45% + 4% (SP-based) of the actual damage dealt. If enhanced by Fervor, this skill gains 70 Penetration when dealing damage. In Auto Battle, this skill prioritizes the area with the most enemies.
